name: Remove.bg
tagline: Remove.bg pioneered instant AI background removal, processing any image in under five seconds with clean, precise edges around hair, fur, and complex subjects. It's available as a web app, desktop app, API, and plugins for Photoshop, Figma, and Canva. E-commerce businesses, photographers, and designers use it to produce clean product shots and cutouts at high volume without manual masking.
